---
title: "climb map creation"
editor: source
---
```{r}
#| label: set-up

library(sf)            
library(dplyr)          
library(leaflet)       
library(htmltools)     
library(rnaturalearth)  
library(leaflet.extras)
library(htmlwidgets)

map <- leaflet(elementId = "climb_map") |> 
  addTiles() |> 
  setView(lat = 34.05,
          lng = -118.24,
          zoom = 6.2
          ) |> 
  addProviderTiles(providers$OpenStreetMap.DE) |> 
  addCircleMarkers(
    lat = c(34.4379, 34.53706, 35.4436, 34.16477, 34.03918, 33.9141),
    lng = c(-119.7891, -120.03997, -120.8231, -118.15031, -118.23445, -115.83981),
    color = "purple"
)
saveWidget(map, file = "climb_map.html", selfcontained = TRUE)
```
